name: Arabica
description: Coffea arabica, the species used by most specialty coffee cultivars.

name: Robusta
description: Coffea canephora, a coffee species also known as robusta.

name: Liberica
description: Coffea liberica, a coffee species with large cherries and seeds.

name: Bourbon
description: A traditional Arabica cultivar descended from Typica.

name: Typica
description: A traditional Arabica cultivar with a broad historical lineage.

name: Caturra
description: A compact mutation of Bourbon selected for shorter plant height.

name: Castillo
description: A Colombian cultivar bred for disease resistance and yield.

name: Colombia
description: A Colombian cultivar blend developed for disease resistance.

name: Geisha
description: A high-aroma Arabica cultivar associated with Panama and Ethiopia.

name: Pacamara
description: A large-seeded cultivar created from Pacas and Maragogipe.

name: SL28
description: A Kenyan Arabica selection known for quality in suitable conditions.

name: SL34
description: A Kenyan Arabica selection associated with high-elevation production.

name: Catimor
description: A group of Arabica hybrids descended from Caturra and Timor Hybrid.

name: Sarchimor
description: A group of Arabica hybrids descended from Villa Sarchi and Timor Hybrid.

name: Eugenioides
description: Coffea eugenioides, a low-caffeine coffee species and Arabica parent.

name: Other variety
description: A documented variety that does not fit another taxonomy entry.
